trophy.firsttorch.end_preparation.descri: Your preparations and return point are checked. The portal is active; the first jump waits for an arrival plan.
image.firsttorch.stronghold_iron_door.de: Left: one Stone makes one Stone Button. Right: the orange-marked Button beside the Iron Door opens it briefly.
image.firsttorch.stronghold_silverfish.d: Infested Stone Bricks can look like ordinary, Mossy or Cracked Stone Bricks. Breaking them can release a Silverfish.
image.firsttorch.end_portal_room.descrip: Top-down orientation: twelve Portal Frames surround the centre with Lava. The Silverfish Spawner is marked in orange.
image.firsttorch.end_portal_frame_states: An empty Portal Frame on the left and a frame with an inserted Eye on the right. Existing and missing Eyes must add up to twelve.
image.firsttorch.bow_and_arrows.descript: Left: the Bow recipe uses three Sticks and three Strings. Right: Flint, a Stick and a Feather make four Arrows.
image.firsttorch.end_portal_final_eye.de: The final empty frame and an outside standing position are marked in orange. Insert the final Eye from safe ground without entering the portal surface.
quest.firsttorch.interior.plan.title: Enter the Stronghold with a Plan
quest.firsttorch.interior.plan.descripti:
Goal: prepare a limited exploration with a clear stopping point.

Return through the marked surface entrance and lit staircase to the closable retreat room. Bring full Iron Armour or better, a Shield, an Iron Sword and Iron Pickaxe or better tools, a Water Bucket, 32 Torches, 32 Cobblestone, and 16 filling cooked foods.

Leave every Eye of Ender safely at home or in a clearly separate Chest at the entrance. This trip only finds and secures the portal room, preventing an accidental right-click from activating the portal.

Choose a firm return limit: turn back before less than half the food or Torches remain, the Pickaxe is close to breaking, or the safe route home becomes uncertain.

Set the checkmark when equipment, the Eye-free inventory, and the stopping rule are checked.
task.firsttorch.197e4a06d1b58f3c.title: Equipment, separated Eyes, and stopping rule checked
quest.firsttorch.interior.routes.title: Mark Every Outward Route
quest.firsttorch.interior.routes.descrip:
Goal: explore only routes that can be followed clearly back to the entrance.

While moving forward, place Torches consistently on the right-hand wall. Those Torches will be on the left while returning. Light every junction and add a Cobblestone marker or Sign there that points towards the secured entrance.

The rule helps but is not magic: Stronghold corridors can form loops, stairs cross several heights, and some doors reconnect known paths. Also record the coordinates and depth of important junctions.

Open only one new route at a junction. Return to the final safe marker before checking a second. Temporarily close checked dark dead ends with conspicuous Cobblestone.

Set the checkmark after the first short corridor is lit, marked, and followed backwards to the retreat room.
task.firsttorch.3b906c28f3d7a15e.title: First Stronghold route marked and return checked
quest.firsttorch.interior.doors.title: Open Iron Doors with a Button
quest.firsttorch.interior.doors.descript:
Goal: understand Iron Doors and carry two Stone Buttons to protect the return route.

A Wooden Door opens directly with right-click. An Iron Door does not respond that way: it needs a Redstone signal. Stronghold corridors often provide a small Stone Button on a neighbouring block for this purpose.

Right-click the Stone Button. The Iron Door opens only briefly and then closes automatically. Stand in the correct position before pressing, check the visible floor beyond the Door, and move through promptly without stopping in the doorway.

Immediately check whether a Button or another control is reachable on the other side. If not, place your own Stone Button on a solid block directly beside the Door. Do not enter another room until the return route can be opened from your side.

One Stone Button is crafted shapelessly from one ordinary Stone. Smelt Cobblestone in a Furnace first; one Stone makes one Button. Hold two Buttons at the same time so both sides can be made safe when a control is missing or removed.

The automatic task completes when two Stone Buttons are in your inventory at the same time.
task.firsttorch.4da17e3904e8b26f.title: Hold 2 Stone Buttons in your inventory at once
quest.firsttorch.interior.silverfish.des:
Goal: understand both hazards before opening more walls.

Dark Stronghold corridors can contain ordinary enemies such as Zombies, Skeletons, and Creepers. Light from a protected position, open doors from the side behind the Shield, and never run blindly into a new room.

Infested forms of Stone, Stone Bricks, Mossy Stone Bricks, and Cracked Stone Bricks can look like ordinary blocks. Breaking one releases a Silverfish. If a Silverfish is hurt without being defeated quickly, it can awaken more nearby infested blocks.

Do not mine whole Stronghold walls unnecessarily. If a Silverfish appears, retreat to the last narrow, lit passage, close the route with Cobblestone, and fight it alone with fully charged strikes. When several appear, retreat instead of chasing them.

Set the checkmark when darkness, ordinary enemies, and infested blocks are understood as separate hazards.
task.firsttorch.5db28e4a15f9c370.title: Stronghold hazards and safe retreat understood
quest.firsttorch.interior.library.title: Libraries Are Optional
quest.firsttorch.interior.library.descri:
Goal: decide whether to inspect a found Stronghold Library now or leave it marked for later.

Strongholds can contain Libraries with Bookshelves, Cobwebs, and Chests, but intersecting generation may also leave a Stronghold without one. A Library is not needed to find or activate the End Portal and never gates the main path.

Remain at the entrance, light visible areas, and check upper levels for enemies before entering. Bookshelves and wood burn: use neither Flint and Steel nor Lava here. Random Chest contents never justify an unsafe jump or fight.

Set the checkmark after deliberately skipping the Library or safely marking and leaving a room that was found. You do not need to find one.
task.firsttorch.7fd4a06c371be592.title: Library deliberately skipped or safely checked
quest.firsttorch.portal.find.title: Find the Portal Room
quest.firsttorch.portal.find.description:
Goal: reach the End Portal room entrance without rushing inside.

Explore the marked corridors one step at a time. The portal room is recognised by a raised arrangement of twelve greenish End Portal Frames around a square centre. The room also contains Lava and a Silverfish Spawner.

The original capture shows a portal room with Eyes still missing and the Silverfish Spawner still present. Doors and damaged walls may differ in your room; the twelve frames, Spawner, and portal centre are the important features.

Remain outside the room at first, behind an opening that can be blocked. Set the checkmark once the frames, Lava, and Spawner have been recognised from safety.
task.firsttorch.21f6c28e593d07b4.title: Portal room found and recognised from the safe entrance
quest.firsttorch.portal.secure.title: Secure the Portal Room
quest.firsttorch.portal.secure.descripti:
Goal: remove the immediate hazards before approaching the frames.

First build a small lit retreat room outside with a closable passage. Lure existing enemies there one at a time. Enter the portal room only when a solid wall can be reached immediately in danger.

Destroy the Silverfish Spawner with the Pickaxe as soon as the route is clear. A Spawner cannot be collected as a block in normal Survival mode; removing this one safely matters more. Retreat immediately if Silverfish appear.

Light the room and temporarily cover reachable open Lava from solid ground with Cobblestone. Never stand on Portal Frames or beside an unsecured Lava edge. Do not alter the twelve frames and continue to insert no Eyes; the later activation lesson explains which temporary cover must be removed again.

Set the checkmark when the retreat room, Spawner, lighting, and reachable Lava edges are controlled.
task.firsttorch.4318e4a07b5f29d6.title: Portal room secured but not activated
quest.firsttorch.portal.count.title: Count the Empty Frames
quest.firsttorch.portal.count.descriptio:
Goal: record how many of the twelve Portal Frames do not yet contain an Eye of Ender.

Walk slowly around the safe outside of the frame. An empty frame shows only its flat greenish top; a filled frame has a clearly raised Eye of Ender on it.

Count all twelve positions and separately record existing Eyes and empty frames. The two numbers must add up to twelve. Continue to hold no Eyes and right-click no frame.

Set the checkmark only after the number of required Eyes is written down. Inserting them follows the End expedition preparation.
task.firsttorch.653a06c29d714bf8.title: All 12 frames checked and missing Eye count recorded
quest.firsttorch.portal.return.title: Return Home with the Result
quest.firsttorch.portal.return.descripti:
Goal: leave the Stronghold by the marked route and prepare the later End journey at home.

Follow the markers backwards to the secured Stronghold entrance and climb to the surface. Check the coordinates again there, then return to base. Replace missing route lighting only from safe positions.

Store the Eyes of Ender together with the recorded empty-frame count. The portal remains inactive. Activation still needs a separate equipment check, an explanation of the first jump's one-way danger, and a plan for arriving in the End.

Set the checkmark when you are home, the route remained traceable, and the frame note lies beside the Eyes.

Reward: one Golden Apple is an emergency reserve for the later journey; ten experience points recognise the controlled Stronghold exploration.
task.firsttorch.075c28e4bf936d1a.title: Safely home with frame note and Eyes stored together
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.jump.title: Understand the First Jump
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.jump.descripti:
Goal: understand the consequences before the portal is even activated.

The first jump takes you to the End's main island. The portal behind you is not an ordinary return route there: the safe way home opens only after defeating the Ender Dragon. The other immediate exit is death, which drops carried items unless the keep inventory game rule is enabled.

The End consists of islands above the Void. Falling into the Void destroys you and every dropped item; Water cannot save you from the Void. Beds explode in the End as they do in the Nether. Water from a Bucket can be placed there and may help against falls or Endermen.

Endermen still attack only after you look directly at them or attack them. A Carved Pumpkin on the head prevents provocation by looking, but severely restricts vision and does not replace careful aim.

Set the checkmark only after understanding that entry is a prepared boss expedition, not a short scouting trip.
task.firsttorch.1a9f5b17e2c6904e.title: One-way danger, Void, Beds, and Water understood
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.bow.title: Bow and Arrows for the Crystals
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.bow.descriptio:
Goal: hold one Bow and 32 Arrows in the inventory at the same time.

A Bow is crafted from three Sticks and three Strings. String comes from sources including Spiders and Cobwebs. Hold right-click to shoot until the Bow is fully drawn, aim, and then release. A barely drawn shot travels only weakly and briefly.

Four Arrows are crafted from one Flint at the top, one Stick in the middle, and one Feather at the bottom. Flint is already familiar from Gravel; Chickens commonly drop Feathers.

The Bow will later be used mainly for the End Crystals that heal the Dragon. Do not waste the Arrows before then. If the Bow has Infinity, one ordinary Arrow in the inventory is enough to shoot; the first predictable attempt still prepares a normal reserve.

Reward: another 32 Arrows add to the 32 prepared personally for a reserve of 64; five experience points recognise the preparation.
task.firsttorch.3cb17d3904e8b270.title: Hold one Bow in the inventory
task.firsttorch.4dc28e4a15f9c381.title: Hold 32 Arrows in the inventory at once
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.pack.title: Pack for the End
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.pack.descripti:
Goal: prepare the complete minimum equipment and check its condition.

Hold these at the same time: an Iron Sword and Iron Pickaxe or something better for each, a Shield, Water Bucket, 64 Cobblestone, 16 filling cooked foods, and the prepared Bow and Arrows. Bring only additional items whose loss would be acceptable.

Wear full Iron Armour or better. Enchanted Diamond Armour is considerably safer but is not an automatic task, avoiding a long forced Diamond grind. Repair badly damaged equipment before leaving. Protection and Feather Falling are especially helpful; a Shield stops neither the Dragon's movement nor a fall into the Void.

The Water Bucket can break a fall onto solid ground and keep Endermen away. Cobblestone provides cover and safe paths. Neither helps after falling into the Void, so never fight directly beside an unsecured edge.

Set the additional checkmark after also checking Armour, durability, Bow, and Arrow reserve.
task.firsttorch.0166c28e593d07c5.title: Hold an Iron Sword or a better Sword
task.firsttorch.1277d39f6a4e18d6.title: Hold an Iron Pickaxe or a better Pickaxe
task.firsttorch.2388e4a07b5f29e7.title: Hold one Shield in the inventory
task.firsttorch.3499f5b18c603af8.title: Hold one Water Bucket in the inventory
task.firsttorch.45aa06c29d714c09.title: Hold 64 Cobblestone in the inventory at once
task.firsttorch.56bb17d3ae825d1a.title: Hold 16 suitable cooked foods in the inventory at once
task.firsttorch.67cc28e4bf936e2b.title: Armour, durability, Bow, and Arrows checked
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.return_point.d:
Goal: prepare a safe respawn and reserve point outside the portal room.

Place a Bed in the lit Stronghold retreat room and sleep in it once to set the respawn point there. Place a Chest beside it with spare food, some blocks, and simple replacement equipment. Store every valuable item that is not needed in the End.

The Bed remains in the Overworld. Never take it through the portal or try to sleep in it in the End, where it explodes. Also check that the route from the respawn point to the portal room is lit, closable, and free from open Lava edges.

Set the checkmark only after sleeping in the Bed, seeing the respawn-point message, and filling the reserve Chest.

Reward: four Bread add to the reserve without replacing the prepared expedition supplies.
task.firsttorch.09ee4a06d1b5904d.title: Respawn point set and reserve Chest prepared
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.return_equippe:
Goal: reach the secured portal room with complete equipment and an intact return route.

Follow the marked route from the surface to the portal room. Close damaged passages, replace missing Torches, and open Iron Doors only when they can be controlled from both sides.

Insert no Eye yet. First check the retreat room, Bed, reserve Chest, Bow, Arrows, Armour, Water Bucket, food, and blocks. Return to base if anything is missing or close to breaking.

Set the checkmark when fully prepared at the secured portal room and the known Overworld route back still works.
task.firsttorch.3c217d3904e8c370.title: Fully equipped at the portal room with return route checked
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.clear.title: Clear the Portal Centre
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.clear.descript:
Goal: prepare the portal centre without falling into Lava or inserting an Eye.

If the three-by-three area inside the Portal Frames was covered with Cobblestone while securing the room, mine that cover now from outside the frame. Never stand on a Portal Frame or jump into the centre. Keep the safe floor beside the frame clear.

Side Lava outside the portal centre may remain covered. Check all twelve frames once more and compare the empty positions with the note. Take exactly the required number of Eyes of Ender from storage; extra Eyes remain in the Chest as reserve.

Set the checkmark when the portal centre is clear, the safe standing position is prepared, and the empty-frame count is confirmed again.
task.firsttorch.5e439f5b260ae592.title: Portal centre clear and empty frames counted again
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.activate.title: Activate the Portal — Do Not Jump Yet
quest.firsttorch.end_prep.activate.descr:
Goal: fill the empty frames from safe ground and remain in the Overworld afterwards.

Stand outside the twelve frames on the prepared solid position. Hold an Eye of Ender and right-click every empty frame individually. Inserted Eyes cannot be removed again.

The original capture shows the result: all twelve Eyes are inserted, the portal surface is active, and the Silverfish Spawner has been removed. Side Lava remains exposed in the image; secure that hazard separately. As soon as the final Eye is inserted, the dark portal surface immediately replaces the clear centre. Any contact with that surface teleports you to the End.

Do not walk across the frames, jump, or press forward after the final click. Step backwards, inspect the active surface from a distance, and leave the End unentered for now. The first entry follows with its own arrival plan.

Set the checkmark only when the portal is active, you are still standing safely before it, and nobody has fallen in accidentally.

Reward: ten experience points recognise the patient activation. The portal itself is not yet an invitation to an unprepared jump.
task.firsttorch.7065b17d482c07b4.title: Portal activated without entering the surface
image.firsttorch.stronghold_iron_door_ca: Original capture: the orange frame and arrow mark the Stone Button to the right of the Iron Door. It opens the Door only briefly.
image.firsttorch.end_portal_room_capture: Original capture of an inactive End Portal with empty and already filled frames. The Silverfish Spawner stands at the front; exposed Lava remains at the sides.
image.firsttorch.end_portal_active_captu: Original capture of the active End Portal with all twelve Eyes and the Silverfish Spawner removed. Side Lava remains exposed and must be secured separately. Do not enter the portal surface yet.
quest.firsttorch.end.0a6fb17d482c07c5.de:
Goal: decide what to do immediately after the loading screen before entering.

You appear on a five-by-five Obsidian platform. It may float freely beside the main island or be partly enclosed in End Stone. Do not walk blindly forwards or jump after loading.

Before jumping, arrange Cobblestone, Pickaxe, Water Bucket, food, and Sword in familiar hotbar positions. Then hold the Cobblestone. After arrival, first stand still, hold Sneak, look slightly down, and inspect the platform, island edge, and Void.

The Ender Dragon is active immediately, but rushing is more dangerous than a short observation. Look at no Enderman face. If the platform is enclosed, keep the Pickaxe ready; if it floats freely, keep the Cobblestone ready.

Set the checkmark only after preparing the hotbar and exact order: stand still, Sneak, look down, inspect the surroundings.
task.firsttorch.5fb406c29d715c1a.title: Hotbar and the first four actions prepared
quest.firsttorch.end.1b70c28e593d18d6.de:
Goal: enter the End for the first time; arrival is detected automatically.

Check full Health, a filled Hunger bar, Armour, and Shield one final time. Confirm that the respawn point is set in the Stronghold retreat room and the reserve Chest waits closed.

Walk into the dark portal surface without a running start. Take your hands off the movement keys during the dimension change. As soon as the surroundings become visible, follow the prepared routine exactly: stand still, hold Sneak, lower the view, and inspect the position first.

The automatic task completes through the real dimension change into the End. It requires no combat yet.
task.firsttorch.60c517d3ae826d2b.title: Enter the End for the first time
quest.firsttorch.end.2c81d39f6a4e29e7.de:
Goal: leave the Obsidian platform with control and reach solid End Stone.

If the platform is enclosed in End Stone, use the Pickaxe to dig a walkable staircase diagonally upwards. Never dig straight up, and open only one block ahead so an edge is not crossed unexpectedly.

If the platform floats beside the island, remain crouched while building. Place Cobblestone against the visible block edge and build a two-block-wide route to the nearest safe End Stone surface. A wider route reduces the fall risk; do not sprint or jump on it.

The in-game capture shows a Cobblestone ascent from the Obsidian platform to the End island. Your distance and height difference may vary. Make your own route at least two blocks wide throughout and protect exposed sides with block railings. Keep Sneak held while building; do not sprint or jump above the Void.

Set the checkmark only from a broad End Stone surface at least several blocks from the nearest unsecured edge. Continue not to look directly at Enderman faces.

Reward: 16 Cobblestone replace part of a possible arrival route; five experience points recognise the safe landing.
task.firsttorch.71d628e4bf937e3c.title: Safely reached solid End Stone
quest.firsttorch.end.3d92e4a07b5f3af8.de:
Goal: prepare a clearly visible retreat point on safe ground.

Choose a flat position far from the island edge. Form a shallow hollow or short Cobblestone rim and empty the Water Bucket into it, making an easily reached Water area that does not flow towards the Void.

Endermen avoid Water and take damage in it. If one is provoked accidentally, do not run towards the island edge: enter the Water, keep the Shield ready, and wait until the route is controllable again. The Dragon can still attack there; this is an Enderman retreat, not invulnerable shelter.

Remember the Obsidian platform and Water area as two separate landmarks. Set the checkmark after the Water is safely reachable and none flows towards the Void.
task.firsttorch.02e739f5c0a48f4d.title: Water retreat prepared on safe End Stone
quest.firsttorch.end.0cb72d9f6a4e29e8.ti: Optional: Build an Enderman Shelter Roof
quest.firsttorch.end.0cb72d9f6a4e29e8.de:
Goal: optionally build a dry retreat that Endermen are too tall to enter.

Choose a broad, level End Stone area at the foot of an Obsidian pillar, far from the Void. Build a three-by-three roof from nine End Stone blocks. Its underside sits exactly two blocks above the ground: you can stand upright beneath it, but an almost three-block-tall Enderman cannot.

The top view marks the safe centre in orange. The side view shows the two clear blocks between ground and roof. Use the Obsidian pillar as an obvious rear wall and remove every temporary support from the interior before testing it.

After provoking an Enderman accidentally, lower the view and move beneath the roof to the centre square. Remain there instead of colliding with it at the edge. If defence is necessary, attack only its legs from inside with fully recovered strikes.

The roof protects only against Enderman height and melee reach. It does not protect against the Dragon, Dragon's Breath, knockback, or the Void. If purple Breath covers the entrance or the Dragon attacks, the roof is not a safe place to remain.

This side branch is entirely optional and does not block the Crystal path. Set the checkmark only if the roof really measures three by three blocks, has two clear blocks of interior height, and its centre can be reached safely.
task.firsttorch.1dc83ea07b5f3af9.title: Build an optional 3 × 3 shelter roof with a safe centre
quest.firsttorch.end.4ea3f5b18c604b09.de:
Goal: recognise the parts of the fight before firing the first Arrow.

End Crystals stand on the tall Obsidian pillars. Visible beams show that they heal the Dragon. Some Crystals are surrounded by Iron Bars. This healing makes attacking the Dragon directly inefficient, so a separate ordered Crystal plan comes first.

The Dragon flies above the island, knocks players away, and leaves purple Dragon's Breath that continues dealing damage on the ground. Leave a purple cloud sideways immediately and heal on safe ground. Do not walk backwards into the Void.

A Bedrock structure stands at the island centre. This is the later exit, but its portal surface appears only after victory. Do not stand unnecessarily beside it during the fight; the Dragon regularly perches there.

Endermen are an additional but avoidable hazard. Keep the view low, attack none, and use the prepared Water retreat after a mistake.

Set the checkmark when pillars, Crystals, Dragon's Breath, Bedrock centre, island edges, and the Water retreat can be distinguished. Shoot no Crystal yet.
task.firsttorch.13f84a06d1b5a05e.title: Battlefield recognised without attacking a Crystal
quest.firsttorch.end.5fa406c29d715c1b.de:
Goal: first destroy every End Crystal that is not surrounded by Iron Bars.

Choose a broad position inside the island and keep well away from the pillar base. Draw the Bow fully, aim at an exposed Crystal, and release the Arrow. One hit is enough, but the Crystal explodes: never shoot from immediate range and do not strike it with a Sword.

The image shows only this first part: hit a clearly exposed Crystal with a distance shot from the ground. Pillar height is shortened in the image.

Move sideways across safe ground after every shot. Check for Dragon's Breath, an approaching Dragon, Hearts, and Hunger before aiming again. Lower the view between shots so no Enderman receives accidental eye contact.

Repeat this only for clearly exposed Crystals. Set the checkmark when no uncaged pillar still holds a Crystal and Health is full or nearly full again.
task.firsttorch.24b95b17e2c6b160.title: Destroy every exposed Crystal from a safe distance
quest.firsttorch.end.60b517d3ae826d2c.de:
Goal: open and destroy the remaining caged Crystals without standing beside their explosions.

Mine 64 End Stone on broad ground without creating unsafe holes beneath your feet. End Stone is better here than carried Cobblestone: the Dragon cannot destroy End Stone. It can still hit or knock you from an exposed staircase.

This image belongs only to the cages: 1 — climb beside the cage and create an opening; 2 — descend completely and only then shoot through the opening from the ground. Pillar height is shortened.

Choose exactly one cage. Build a narrow rising End Stone staircase from the ground close against its Obsidian pillar. Remain crouched, never work above the Void, and go down several steps whenever the Dragon approaches. Do not run on the staircase.

Climb only until an Iron Bar can be reached from the side. Use the Pickaxe to remove only enough of one cage side for an Arrow to pass later. Never strike the Crystal and do not enter the cage. Return completely to the ground along the same staircase.

Move far enough back for a clear shot and destroy the Crystal with a fully drawn Bow through the opening. Repeat the entire sequence one cage at a time; never combine climbing and shooting into one action.

The item task detects 64 End Stone automatically. Set the checkmark only after every caged Crystal has been destroyed from safe ground distance and you stand on broad End Stone again.
task.firsttorch.35ca6c28f3d7c271.title: Hold 64 End Stone for safe climbs at the same time
task.firsttorch.46db7d3904e8d382.title: Open every cage separately and destroy its Crystal from the ground
quest.firsttorch.end.71c628e4bf937e3d.de:
Goal: verify the result and regroup before the actual Dragon fight begins.

Inspect all ten Obsidian pillars in turn. No End Crystal may remain on any top. If a healing beam still reaches the Dragon, one Crystal remains: do not attack the Dragon, but search the pillars systematically again.

Then return to the safe Water area. Eat until the Hunger bar is full, wait for healing, and inspect Armour, Shield, Bow, Pickaxe, Water Bucket, and remaining Arrows. Keep Dragon's Breath out of the route by waiting for the purple cloud to disappear; do not walk through it.

Set the checkmark only after confirming ten empty pillar tops, no visible healing beam, and restored Health. The next step explains the Dragon fight; do not deliberately attack it before then.

Reward: 16 Arrows replace some of the Crystal shots. Ten experience points recognise the completely disabled healing cycle.
task.firsttorch.57ec8e4a15f9e493.title: Confirm ten empty pillars, no healing, and a ready regroup
